basic_info.description: Beautiful 3 bedroom + office, 1.25 bath Victorian in Bernal Heights blends original character with modern updates and expansion potential. Enter on the second level through a covered porch into a bright office/den and a west-facing dining room. The hallway features a remodeled bath with a jacuzzi tub, skylight, and designer tile. A spacious living room boasts a skylight, refinished parquet floors, and built-ins. The updated kitchen includes stainless steel appliances, black granite counters, newly painted cabinets with modern pulls, and luxury vinyl plank flooring. Adjacent, the primary bedroom offers a deep closet and a large window overlooking the backyard. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms with picturesque views are separated by a convenient water closet. A deck off the kitchen is perfect for alfresco dining, leading to a landscaped backyard with mature trees for privacy. The lower level features a laundry room, generous basement storage, and a 1-car garage. Recent updates include new light fixtures, new electrical panel, new roof, refinished hardwood floors, fresh interior paint, and new exterior siding at the rear. Enjoy southern hill views, easy access to Cortland Ave, and Highway 280 & 101. A fantastic opportunity to expand or make this your ideal starter home.
